description:
Search code or paths. Regex is on by default; set regex=false for exact text. searches[] batches independent content/path-glob searches; queries[] is advanced weighted ranking.
Use when: locate code or text before reading; narrow relative_path for speed.
Avoid when: use read_file for known paths, outline_symbol for structure, or symbol_references for usages.

files_hint.description: Advanced: limit queries[] to these paths (max 20).

glob.description: Filter content-search paths; path-only globs use searches[].type=glob.

queries.description: Advanced: weighted patterns; overrides query/kind. Hits include score and matched patterns.

query.description: Use query OR searches[] (not both). Regex by default; set regex=false for exact text.

relative_path.description: File or folder to scan (default: workspace root).

searches.description: Batch up to 8 independent searches; each result includes its index and type.

pattern.description: Regex by default; glob pattern for type=glob.

relative_path.description: Item scope; defaults to the top-level path.

type.description: Content search or path glob; engine is automatic.
